name: Guo Yue
bio: Guo Yue, an actor, graduated from the Department of Directing of the China Academy of Opera. In 2012, she starred in her first film "Female Director" and officially entered the showbiz. In 2014, she came to prominence as the female lead Yang Yang in the sci-fi film "Kaili Blues".
